originalTitle: Is 'Trumpflation' real? Why Wall Street fears this could be a reason for stock market crash
simplifiedContent: There's a concern on Wall Street that something called "Trumpflation" could cause the stock market to crash. This concern is growing because of rising prices and higher interest rates. The core inflation rate is currently at 3.3%, which is considered high, and this could lead the Federal Reserve to keep interest rates high or even raise them. This matters because higher interest rates can make it more expensive for companies to borrow money, which could affect their stock prices and the overall stock market. As a result, some investors are worried that the high values of stocks might not be sustainable.

originalTitle: World Bank's IFC, HDFC AMC invest in Molbio Diagnostics' Rs 281 crore IPO anchor round
simplifiedContent: Molbio Diagnostics, a company based in Goa, is planning to raise money by selling its shares to the public, which is called an Initial Public Offering (IPO). Before the IPO opens on August 10, the company has already raised Rs 281 crore from some big investors, including the World Bank's IFC and HDFC Mutual Fund. This is called an "anchor round" and it's a sign that these investors believe in the company's potential. The company also had some existing investors sell their shares, worth Rs 160 crore, which is a normal part of the process. This investment is significant because it shows that major investors are interested in the company, which could be a good sign for its future.

originalTitle: Market Trading Guide: Jindal Saw among 2 stock recommendations for Monday
simplifiedContent: Here's a simplified version of the news: A market guide has recommended two stocks to consider investing in on Monday, and one of them is Jindal Saw. This recommendation comes after many companies in India have recently reported their earnings, which is the money they made. Most of these companies have met or exceeded expectations, which is a positive sign for their respective sectors. This means that people are feeling more optimistic about certain areas of the market, which could be a good time to invest. The recommendation of Jindal Saw and another stock suggests that they might be good choices to consider for investment on Monday.

originalTitle: US Markets Week Ahead: Inflation, retail sales, home sales and earnings in focus
simplifiedContent: This week, investors will be paying close attention to some important numbers that can give them an idea of how strong the US economy is. These numbers include how much prices are rising (inflation), how many homes are being sold, and how much people are buying from stores (retail sales). Last week, there was a surprise when it was announced that not as many new jobs were created as expected, so investors are looking for clues about what the economy will do next. The Federal Reserve, which helps control the economy, will also be watching these numbers to decide what to do with interest rates. This information is important because it can help investors make decisions about where to put their money.

originalTitle: The stock market is finally rising again—and it’s getting cheaper, too
simplifiedContent: The stock market, which is like a big store where people buy and sell pieces of companies, is doing better now after a tough time. The S&P 500, a way to measure how the biggest companies are doing, has gone up 22% in the past year. Even though the market is going up, the price of buying into it, called the valuation, has actually gone down. This is a good thing because it means that investors can buy into the market at a relatively cheaper price. This matters because it could be a good time for people to invest in the stock market, as they can get in at a lower price.

originalTitle: Upcoming IPOs: Shiprocket IPO, Dhoot Transmission IPO among new issues to open next week; full list here
simplifiedContent: Some companies, including Shiprocket and Dhoot Transmission, are planning to sell their shares to the public for the first time, which is called an Initial Public Offering (IPO). These IPOs will be open for people to buy into between August 10 and 12. At the same time, shares from eight other companies that started selling last week will begin trading on the market. This is important because it gives people a chance to invest in these companies and potentially make money if their shares increase in value. The list of new IPOs is available for those who want to learn more about the companies and consider investing.
